hitindication.configuration.title: Hit Indication Configuration
hitindication.configgui.title: Hit Indication Configuration
hitindication.configgui.max_indicator_co: Determines maximum indicator count shown on screen (0 = unlimited).
hitindication.configgui.display_hits_fro: Shows red indicator when an entity hits the player with a non-damaging negative potion.
hitindication.configgui.fade_rate.toolti: Amount of ticks after which indicator disappears.
hitindication.configgui.display_blue_ind: Shows blue indicator when the player blocks incoming damage with a shield.
hitindication.configgui.size_depends_on_: Any instance of damage that deals 30 percent or more of max health will result in larger indicators.
hitindication.configgui.distance_from_cr: Determines distance of an indicator from crosshair.
hitindication.configgui.enable_non_direc: Shows a special indicator when hit direction can't be determined.
hitindication.configgui.enable_distance_: Scale of the indicator depends on the distance.
hitindication.configgui.distance_scaling: Distance from entity after which indicator starts to become gradually smaller.
hitindication.configgui.edge_of_screen_m: The indicators will appear on the edges of your screen instead of near the crosshair.
hitindication.configgui.hit_indicator_co: Determines the color of the hit indicator (hex RGB, e.g. FF0000).
hitindication.configgui.block_indicator_: Determines the color of the block indicator (hex RGB, e.g. 0000FF).
